paragraphs.text: # dsh-weread
English | 中文
WeChat Reading (WeRead) right-sidebar bookshelf and chapter reader for DeepSeek Harness.
## Features

- Right-sidebar panel: bookshelf, store search, prominent Continue card
- Shelf filters (All / Readi

ng / Finished) with progress and reading-time labels
- Cover-first bookshelf, with a list view toggl

e
- Merges local vs cloud progress by recency; syncs progress and reading time back to WeRead
- Sign

in with WeChat QR or Cookie; expired sessions offer a one-tap re-login
- Reader dock with chapter p

rogress and TOC; ←→ / Space / side-click paging
- Demo book when signed out
- Agent tools (registere
d when the names are free): `weread_shelf`, `weread_search`, `weread_book`, `weread_chapter`
> If weread-export is already installed, some tool names may already be taken; this plugin still ser
ves the sidebar UI and `/api/weread`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or install from a local path / npm once published.
Restart Harness after install, then open the **WeRead** tab in the right sidebar.
